channel.name: Paise Ki Pathshala
channel.tagline: ट्रेडिंग की पाठशाला — चार्ट, पैटर्न, रिस्क और असली डेटा
channel.format: Trader Shorts — ek fact ya ek concept, seedha samjhao
channel.audience: Indian traders — retail se pro tak (Hindi)
channel.banner_line: SIP · FD · Tax · EMI · Credit Card · Insurance
description: पैसे की वो बातें जो स्कूल में नहीं सिखाई जातीं।
हर वीडियो में एक नियम — SIP, FD, टैक्स, EMI, क्रेडिट कार्ड, बीमा, लोन — आसान हिंदी में, असली नंबरों के साथ।
यह चैनल सिर्फ़ शिक्षा के लिए है। हम किसी शेयर, म्यूचुअल फंड या प्रोडक्ट को खरीदने-बेचने की सलाह नहीं देते। निवेश से पहले SEBI-रजिस्टर्ड सलाहकार से सलाह लें।

branding.visual_style: Original single boxed chart card inside the Shorts-safe board area. Preserve clear margins, readable labels, our own palette and hand-drawn charts. Reveal one chart layer at a time and use one focal callout; use side-by-side mini-charts only when the topic truly compares two cases.
branding.thumbnail_style: Original red hook card with a crop of our own boxed chart, concise Hindi hook, and topic-bank sticker. Keep SEO title and description descriptive and topic-specific; never reuse competitor images, titles, or exact layouts.

models._note: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash (latest) — low cost. Use deepseek-v4-pro if script quality drops.

formats._comment: VIDEO_FORMAT=short (run_pipeline.py --format short) par ye values upar ke config par chadh jaati hain. Har topic ka ek short aur ek long banta hai (pick_topic: used / used_short).

voice._note: Kamal (qsz5tTEjPvsiIJZIpM8S) is a Hindi male narrator in the ElevenLabs voice library: calm, not the energetic Krishna voice. It is not one of the default premade voices, so this id is configurable — if the account cannot use that library voice, set formats.short.voice.voice_id. Stability 0.78, style 0 and speed 1.0 keep delivery slow and clear. Edge hi-IN-MadhurNeural at +0% is the male fallback. Do not raise edge_rate above +10%. Swara is not used for Shorts.

instagram._note: grid_safe_cover: IG-only cover copy (run/ig_cover.jpg) that keeps the thumbnail title inside the 3:4 profile-grid crop. YouTube thumbnail unchanged.

research._note: competitor_research.py (optional, read-only). Needs secret YT_DATA_API_KEY, or falls back to the channel OAuth token. Missing creds = step skipped, pipeline unaffected.

trends._note: trend_research.py daily job. quota_budget_units is clamped to 1200 in code (search.list = 100). Do not raise it to chase more queries; uploads share the same 10,000-unit day.
